title: Pet Event – Create your favourite Combo
summary: What if your favorite character had a pet of their own? Create a Character + Pet duo and show us what they’d be like together!
body_markdown:
What if your favorite character had a pet of their own? Create a Character + Pet duo and show us what they’d be like together!


**🎨 Mission:** Create a Character + Pet duo in Redbean!


**📅 Time:** September 10 – September 24


**🎮 How to join:**


1. Create a pet for your favorite charact by er in Redbean.
2. Take a screenshot or video of your duo in the game.
3. Share your creation in[Redbean Discord](https://discord.gg/xMvVRX6cnH)


The top 3 entries with the most reactions will win:


- 🥇 2,000 Credits
- 🥈 1,000 Credits
- 🥉 500 Credits


**Note:**


- Multiple entries are allowed, but each participant can only win once.
- By entering, you allow Redbean to feature your submission with credit.
- ​Winners are determined by the number of voters.​​


Go make the cutest, funniest duo ever! Can’t wait to see your creations!
